name: ECOSYS
recent: ECOSYS 于 2026 年 10 月 14 日在 ACE Market 上市，IPO 公开发售部分超额认购 206.7 倍，首日股价大涨 196%。上市前公布的 2026 财年第四季（截至 6 月 30 日）营收环比增长 37.4%，净利环比增长 39.3%。上市后数日，董事与高管出现例行股权申报，包括一名非独立非执行主席在公开市场减持 10 万股。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 10 月 14 日在 Bursa Malaysia 的 ACE Market 上市，IPO 发行价为每股 RM0.27。
IPO 公开发售部分获超额认购 206.7 倍。
上市首日股价较 IPO 发行价上涨 196%。
risks: 非独立非执行主席 GAN TECK HOOI 于 2026 年 10 月 14 日在公开市场以每股 RM0.820 减持 100,000 股（占 0.018%）。
董事与高管在 IPO 粉表配售中认购新股，包括董事及首席财务官。
上市后因扩大后股本，董事持股出现稀释。
earnings: 2026 财年第四季（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 30,989,000，环比增长 37.4%；净利为 MYR 3,121,000，环比增长 39.3%；净利率为 10.1%，上一季为 9.9%。

recent_en: ECOSYS debuted on the ACE Market on 14 October 2026, with its IPO public portion oversubscribed 206.7 times and shares surging 196% on the first day. For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 37.4% QoQ and net profit rose 39.3% QoQ. In the days after listing, directors and senior management made routine shareholding disclosures, including a non-independent non-executive chairperson disposing of 100,000 shares in the open market.
notable_en: The company listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia on 14 October 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.27 per share.
The IPO public portion was oversubscribed 206.7 times.
The share price rose 196% above the IPO price on its debut day.
risks_en: Non-Independent Non-Executive Chairperson GAN TECK HOOI disposed of 100,000 shares (0.018%) in the open market at RM0.820 per share on 14 October 2026.
Directors and senior management, including directors and the CFO, subscribed for new shares under the IPO Pink Form allocation.
Director shareholdings were diluted due to the enlarged share capital following the listing.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 30,989,000, up 37.4% QoQ; net profit was MYR 3,121,000, up 39.3% QoQ; net margin was 10.1% versus 9.9% in the previous quarter.
